scope: Corollary 6.2 (Logarithmic subadditivity) of the manuscript “Orbifold and logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Orbifold-and-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b143366cc99615e1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 40-41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let f : X → Y be a surjective morphism with connected fibers between smooth connected projective complex varieties. Let DX, DY be reduced simple normal crossing divisors, with the zero divisor allowed, such that Supp(f∗ DY ) ⊆ Supp(DX). For a very general fiber F, put DF = DX|F . Then (6.7) κ(X, KX + DX) ≥ κ(F, KF + DF ) + κ(Y, KY + DY ). ORBIFOLD AND LOGARITHMIC IITAKA SUBADDITIVITY 41 The same statement holds for compact manifolds in Fujiki class C and holomorphic fibrations between them.
